claims.statement: shared/src/calculations/ holds the single source of truth for financial math — round2dp/roundInt (round.ts), computeTripTotals + computeRoadAllowance + computeDriverRoadAllowance + computeExVatAmount (tripTotals.ts), tripDriverSalary.ts (computeTripDriverSalary, resolveTripDriverSalary, TRIP_SALARY_WORK_DAYS), fifoAging.ts (computeFifoAging), iso6346.ts (container check-digit), vehicleAlerts.ts (computeVehicleAlerts), billingDocument.ts (canonicalFreightDescription), and tripFormDefaults.ts (FUEL_*_FALLBACK, ROAD_ALLOWANCE_PER_KM_FALLBACK); every file has a colocated *.test.ts (Vitest).

Storage vs display rule: monetary columns are stored as numeric(precision, 0) for ledger amounts and numeric(15, 2) for cost/price fields; the display layer (frontend formatCurrency) drops decimals — VND never has fractional đồng in the UI; round2dp preserves 2 decimal places for intermediate math while roundInt is used at the display boundary.

Fuel modes in computeTripTotals: AUTO = sum of (leg.km × norm/100) + fuelPerTripSupplement; FLAT_RATE (Khoán) = fuelLitersOverride; MOUNTAIN allowance is encoded as mountainFixedAllowance per-route total that overrides per-km math (route classification does not gate it); supplement (fuelSupplementLiters) is additive on top of either mode; per-purchase pricing (commit 1384245) makes totalFuelCost = Σ round(liters × row.unitPrice ?? effective).

Road allowance formula: Tiền đường ròng = Tiền chuẩn (RoadAllowanceBase, lookup Route × TrailerType) − (Số trạm × 55.000) + returnCargoBonus − tollsDiscount + tollsAddition; totalRoadAllowance = roadAllowanceOverride ?? Tiền đường ròng + twoPointDeliveryBonus; tollCost is tracked separately as tollsStations × tollPerStation.

VAT asymmetry: revenue is recorded ex-VAT (freightExVat = revenue / (1 + vatRate); equals revenue when vatRate=0) and costs are recorded incl-VAT — do not normalize between the two; ancillary fees carry buyAmount (incl-VAT cost to company) and sellAmount (incl-VAT billed to customer) plus optional vatRate (default 0.080) and post SERVICE_FEE to the customer ledger for debit notes without creating payable/cost ledger entries.

FIFO aging (computeFifoAging) is used by receivables.service.ts (FIFO ordering of oldest unpaid trips) and payables.service.ts with inverted direction (age open credits, apply debits FIFO — no per-expense matching, payments reduce the running balance); trip driver salary (computeTripDriverSalary, resolveTripDriverSalary, TRIP_SALARY_WORK_DAYS) combines base salary + productivity bonus + per-trip income − penalties; tripFormDefaults.ts exports fallback constants (FUEL_PRICE_PER_LITER_FALLBACK, FUEL_LOADED_NORM_FALLBACK, FUEL_EMPTY_NORM_FALLBACK, ROAD_ALLOWANCE_PER_KM_FALLBACK).
